meta.title: Credit Cards
meta.subtitle: Register cards, add spend and installments

actions.alignDueDays: Put installment days back on the cutoff

form.name: Card name
form.openingBalanceHint: Enter if the card already has a balance. Leave empty otherwise.
form.chargeHint: Not added to Transactions. Cash leaves your account when you pay the card.
form.editChargeHint: Paid installments are kept. Fix due dates per row, or set the first pending due date and align.
form.editPaidBlocked: Charges with paid installments cannot be rebuilt; only category/description can change.
form.firstPendingDueDateHint: Leave empty to use the statement cutoff. A 26 Sep purchase with cutoff 15 is first due on 15 Oct.
form.editCardHint: The cutoff day sets both the statement period and the installment due day. A 26 Sep purchase is first due on the 15 Oct statement.
form.bulkExpenseHint: Add single and installment purchases row by row to catch the card up. Empty amount rows are skipped.
form.paidInstallmentsHint: Use when catching up an existing card. Paid rows appear on the plan but no cash expense is created; remaining debt uses pending only.

detail.noSchedule: No plan yet — add an expense
detail.selectHint: Select a card for details and spending
detail.goDebtsHint: Card payments and statement summaries also appear under Debts.
detail.chargesCollapsedHint: Tap a row to expand installments
detail.noPeriodItems: No pending installments in this statement period

toast.dueDaysAligned: {{count}} installment dates now use the cutoff day
toast.categoryRequired: Pick a category on every filled row

confirm.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
